## Guajona (CR 3)

This thin, humanoid figure has wrinkled, yellow skin and bird-like taloned feet, with knots of thorny brambles in place of hands and a single long, curving fang stretching down almost to its chin.  

**XP** 800  
NE Medium aberration  
**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 natural)  
**hp** 50 (5d8+10)  
**Fort** +5, **Ref** +5, **Will** +5; **Weaknesses** vulnerability to fire  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** curved fang +6 (1d6+3 plus anesthetic spittle) or claw +5 (1d4+3 slashing plus grab)  
**Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** snatching brambles  


**Statistics**


**Str** 16, **Dex** 17, **Con** 14, **Int** 12, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 3  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +6 (+10 grapple); **CMD** 19  
**Feats** Ability focus (anesthetic spittle), improved grapple  
**Skills** Stealth +9, Survival +7  
**Languages** Common, Aklo  


**Special Abilities**



**Anesthetic Spittle (Ex)** Curved fang—injury; save Fort DC 16; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Str and 1d2 Dex; cure 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based and includes the +2 bonus from Ability Focus.  

**Burns in Sunlight (Ex)** When a guajona ends its turn in direct sunlight, it bursts into flames, taking 1d6 points of fire damage and taking a -20 penalty on Stealth checks until the end of its next turn. Ending a turn out of the sun quenches the flames.  

**Snatching Brambles (Ex)** As a standard action, the guajona can stretch its bramble-claws out to make a claw attack against a target within 30 feet. If the guajona successfully grapples a Medium or smaller target, the target gains the grappled condition but the guajona does not (though she cannot make other claw attacks as long as it maintains the grapple). If the target is Medium or smaller, the guajona can make a second grapple maneuver as a free action against the same target; if it succeeds, the creature is pulled 10 feet toward the guajona.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** caves and urban areas  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** incidental
